Browse the palettes

Source: vignettes/articles/browse.Rmd
browse.Rmd

Every character in transformeRs, with its colours, where it came from, and a photo of the original toy. Filter by faction, combiner team, role or what kind of plot the palette suits, click a swatch to copy its hex code, and use Suggest a change on any card to open a prefilled GitHub issue where you can propose different colours or attach a better photograph. Missing someone? Request a character.

Suits:

Copied

Suggesting changes

Every palette here is an approximation read off toy photographs, so corrections are welcome. Each card links to a prefilled GitHub issue form:

  • Suggest a change if a colour is wrong, missing, or should be removed, or if the description, alternate mode, year or photo is off. Say which hex codes you would add, change or drop and why; a photo of the toy under neutral light is the best evidence.
  • Request a character if a Transformer or team you care about is not covered yet. The wishlist shows what is already queued.

You need a GitHub account to open an issue. If you would rather not, email the maintainer listed in the package DESCRIPTION.
